slots.title: Trump Media wants to clear $884 million of debt without selling its bitcoin
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Truth Social owner bought back $100 million of convertible notes this week. Holders of the rest can demand cash on Nov. 30, and its bitcoin is worth just under $1 billion.

slots.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.

slots.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.

slots.title: Crypto traders vs. Wall Street: OKX’s Anthropic markets put IPO pricing to the test
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The crypto exchange plans to launch tokenized Anthropic shares as its pre-IPO futures trade about 24% above the company’s $83 offering price.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain
